requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:30-52 no-op on null/empty URL (`is_string($url) && trim($url) !== ''`), `Http::timeout(5)->asJson()->post($url, ['content' => ...])`, non-2xx and Throwable both logged at error with status / scrubbed message; :69 `mb_substr(..., 0, 1800, 'UTF-8')`; :26 key regex covers password|token|secret|authorization|api[_-]?key|webhook case-insensitively; :28 bearer regex; :72-83 recursive redaction then JSON render. config/logging.php:57 LOG_STACK default 'daily', :78-84 audit channel daily/audit.log/info/90; config/services.php:31-33 services.discord.webhook_url; .env.example and phpunit.xml:29 LOG_STACK=daily; no discord channel. The daily channel is not touched in the diff, so it relies on the existing Laravel default (`LOG_DAILY_DAYS`, 14); the test checks for it.

conventions.evidence: Test-first style with Pest tests under tests/Feature/Ops; CHANGELOG.md updated under Added/Changed; PHPDoc on the class. Small deviation: conventions.md links the logging guide as `docs/ops/logging.md`, but the change adds `docs/ops/observability.md`, so the conventions link points to a file this diff does not create.

security.evidence: Webhook URL never logged: non-2xx logs only `['status' => ...]` (DiscordOpsAlert.php:44); exception message passed through `scrub()` (:104-110), which removes the exact URL and any `/api/webhooks/...` path. sanitize() also redacts any payload string that contains the webhook URL. Nested secrets are redacted before JSON encoding. .env.example comment marks the URL as a secret.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Ops/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php covers the no-op for null and '' (with Http::assertNothingSent), the exact POST URL and JSON body, multibyte truncation to exactly 1800, every redaction rule including nested and bearer, the non-2xx log, and a transport exception whose message contains the URL. LoggingChannelsTest.php checks the config shape. Gaps: no test actually writes `Log::channel('audit')->info(...)`, and the `toBe(14)`/`toBe(90)` int assertions break if a local .env sets these keys, because env() returns strings.

simplicity.evidence: One small class with private helpers and constants. It uses Laravel's Http client and Log facade, and reuses the existing config/logging.php and services.php structure. There are no extra abstractions or service-provider bindings.

readability.evidence: Clear names (compose/redact/render/sanitize/scrub), `match (true)` blocks that read cleanly, named constants (MAX_LENGTH, TIMEOUT_SECONDS, SENSITIVE_KEY, BEARER) and a brief comment on the 1800 margin. Tests have descriptive names.

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task: notifier, config, env example, phpunit.xml, docs/ops, CHANGELOG and tests. The notifier is not wired into any job or handler (stated in docs/ops/observability.md:284).

issues.explanation: `'days' => env('LOG_AUDIT_DAYS', 90)` returns the string "90" when the key is set in .env (as .env.example now does), so `logging.channels.audit.days` is not the integer 90 the contract and the test expect; casting with `(int)` would make it deterministic.
The audit channel is checked only as config; no test performs `Log::channel('audit')->info(...)` to prove the channel accepts writes, which the task explicitly requires.

Strict `toBe(14)`/`toBe(90)` assertions depend on the env keys being unset; a developer .env copied from .env.example yields strings and fails the suite, which runs against the task's goal of not depending on a local .env.
conventions.md links the logging guide as `docs/ops/logging.md`; the new doc uses a different file name, so that reference is left dangling.

review.summary: Adds a compact, soft-failing DiscordOpsAlert that redacts secrets, truncates multibyte text to 1800 characters and never logs the webhook URL. It also adds the audit channel, moves the stack default to daily, and ships thorough Pest tests and a clear decision-guide doc. The remaining issues are minor: string-vs-int env casting for retention days, no test that actually writes to the audit channel, and a doc filename that does not match the conventions link, so this is approve with nits.
